notes.subject: ובאחת
notes.rationale: 'wantaim olgeta' (united) vs Vulgate 'in one' (wanpela tok) vs Peshitta 'in vain' — ol translate i senis

notes.subject: יבערו
notes.gloss: בער i min 'olsem animal i no gat tingting' — Tok Pisin 'olsem dok i no gat tingting'

notes.subject: מוסר הבלים עץ הוא
notes.rationale: 'skulim long ol samting nating — em i diwai' — constructs i bruk: 'ol samting nating i skulim ol' o 'skul bilong ol samting nating em i diwai'

translation: Na wantaim olgeta ol i olsem dok i no gat tingting na ol i no save; ol i skulim ol long ol samting nating — em i diwai tasol.

tokens.gloss: ol i olsem dok i no gat tingting
